findings.message: Fictional numerical and case illustrations: All monetary figures, enterprise cases, household budgets, and loan illustrations across Topic 5.1, Topic 5.2, and Unit Assessment are original fictional teaching cases designed for pedagogical instruction. They are not empirical survey findings, quantified intervention effects, or official poverty statistics.

Headless review tooling constraint: The crew job brief explicitly prohibits running npm run build, a dev server, or Playwright Chromium. Visual and presentation checks were conducted via measure-figure-text.mjs (all 8 SVG variants exit 0 with zero overflow or collision), static heading and table container analysis, and Sharp PNG rasterization with CSS variables resolved.

Global glossary entries: Unit 5 tags ten key terms with <Glossary term="..."> matching existing global entries (Economy, Poverty, Human capital, Family, Role, Social institution, Joint family, Nuclear family, Culture). New economic terms are defined inline on first use; repository-wide glossary expansion remains a separate task outside unit scope.

Print monographs declared under Verification and limits: Burki (1999) and Rabbani were unavailable in this session and are declared in specs/content/gpks-402/sources/unit-05.md:28-32 per D-2026-0001. No specific proposition relies on them; verified open-access substitutes ground all unit prose.
